profile_text.body:
Inceptive, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, describes itself as building "foundation models of life" to design medicines for challenging diseases. The company states that its models extrapolate from data to enable breakthrough drug discovery, and it positions itself at the intersection of AI and biology, with an antidisciplinary team of scientists, AI researchers, and engineers.

The company emphasizes partnerships as strategic alliances focused on tuning models, utilizing data, and transferring knowledge. According to its website, Inceptive believes AI models can deliver significant benefit to humanity by learning the mechanisms of life and designing novel therapies, and it is actively hiring across AI and biology disciplines.
